content.short: 0xStation lets contributors submit paid bounties and helps DAOs manage contributors, payments, and delivery workflows.
content.description: 0xStation is an advanced payment tool optimized for completing DAO bounties. It offers a highly customizable payment structure that gives control over bounty issuance, contributor management, and delivery workflows. Contributors can propose tasks, set a price, and submit them for DAO approval. By unifying proposal, review, and payout steps, 0xStation helps both developers seeking to contribute to DAOs and DAOs aiming to streamline their bounty programs and payments.
content.meta: 0xStation manages DAO bounties, contributors, and payment workflows. Discover 0xStation and other DAO Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
